name: regression

version.labels: L2 2026-11-08 16:20 PT (owner relabels: entropy, DNS, decision tree)

measures: Six prompts, each with one known-right diagram kind (regressionKind); a regression is any run without that kind.
written: 2026-11-08 15:12 PT, the kind regression set (owner): pass = best kind in 3 of 3
relabels: 2026-11-08 ~16:20 PT owner relabel (applied before scoring 5e, 5d re-scored): entropy: transformation = right, relationship = acceptable
notation: A mix is a list of visuals: P = a Recraft picture, D:<kind> = a TutorDiagram of that kind (D:a|b = either kind, D:* = any kind). best = the mixes judged right; acceptable = a weaker mix that still teaches; anything else is wrong. badKinds = diagram kinds that cannot draw this subject (flagged wherever they appear, even beside a picture).

prompts.prompt: how does the water cycle work?
prompts.why: A repeating process: cycle. A landscape picture is a fair second.

prompts.prompt: how does the TCP handshake work?
prompts.why: Messages between two actors in order: sequence. A picture can only be decoration.
A real stack: the one case where layers is the right kind.

prompts.prompt: how does a binary search tree work?
prompts.why: A hierarchy (tree), optionally the search path (flow). A picture cannot carry the key labels (no text in pictures).

prompts.prompt: how did the Roman Empire rise and fall?
prompts.why: Events in time: timeline. A picture of Rome is a fair second.
Ordered to disordered: a before/after transformation, or a picture of ice melting / gas spreading.
